final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won * 1.0 / v.points_max) AS avg_ratio FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.death_country, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / o.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL
